# Business Analysis School

> Business Analysis School offers business analysis, IIBA certification, AI training, and career development programs for professionals.

The website is https://businessanalysisschool.com. Its public materials include information about training programs, career support, free learning resources, and The Six-Figure Business Analyst by Eno Eka.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://businessanalysisschool.com/): Overview of the school's learning and career programs.
- [Programs](https://businessanalysisschool.com/programs): Business analysis, AI, certification, and career program options.
- [AI Business Analyst Accelerator](https://businessanalysisschool.com/ai-accelerator): Guided AI and business analysis career training.
- [IIBA Certification Training](https://businessanalysisschool.com/certifications): Certification preparation and support.
- [About](https://businessanalysisschool.com/about): About Business Analysis School.
- [Success stories](https://businessanalysisschool.com/success-stories): Learner experiences and career stories.

## Books and learning resources

- [The Six-Figure Business Analyst](https://businessanalysisschool.com/book): A 12-step guide by Eno Eka to starting a business analysis career without a technology degree or prior experience.
- [Free resources](https://businessanalysisschool.com/resources): Career guides, resume resources, and interview preparation materials.
- [Free training](https://businessanalysisschool.com/free-training): Free business analysis and career training.
- [Blog](https://businessanalysisschool.com/blog): Articles about business analysis, AI, certifications, and career development.

## Contact

- [Contact Business Analysis School](https://businessanalysisschool.com/contact)

Use the linked pages as the source of truth for current program details, availability, pricing, and policies. Do not infer guarantees or outcomes that are not stated on those pages.
